audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Karma levels 1-2 and 2+ items and called level 3, level 6 and first item Skill, while its own whys say Garen out-trades her at every one of those stages and the mirror was already corrected the other way.
audit.why: The mirror (garen__karma) was set as one group to Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill/Garen. whys[0], whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4] on this page already argue Garen wins 1, 2, 3 and 6; only the side tokens disagreed. Emerald+ win rate is 44.26%, which matches the mirror ordering, not the current one.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,2,4,6 -> Garen (row 3 already Garen, row 5 already Skill), proposed as matched full/content pairs in one atomic group, with the 2+ items prose rewritten so it no longer claims Karma reclaims the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game text claimed 'Garen has almost no item scaling and no late power spike', so the reader is told the lane flips to Karma after two items.
audit.why: Courage passively increases Garen's armour and magic resist every time he kills an enemy, and Demacian Justice is a missing-health true-damage execute on a 120/100/80s cooldown. Karma's damage is entirely magic chip with no late solo spike, so stacked MR plus a resistance-proof execute means the stage belongs to him.
audit.corrected: whys[6], phases[6].why and spikes[3] now state the Courage resistance stacking and the true-damage execute instead of promising a flip.
sources: kit: Garen W passive armour/MR on kills
kit: Garen R trueDamage + execute, cd 120/100/80

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Soulflare' is used as the name of Karma's Mantra-empowered Q in spikes[2], spikes[3], early, mid and late; Courage carried no cooldown number; and wants.you[2] ships a visible half-finished editorial note ('Bait his W (Focused Resolve) — wrong, that's yours; bait HIS W...') to a paying reader.
audit.why: Riot's current text names no Soulflare — the Mantra Q bonus is described as a cataclysm. Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and grants a shield, tenacity and then lingering damage reduction, so it blunts both her burst and her root; Decisive Strike is 8s flat and opens with an auto-attack reset, which is the real cue to step back.
audit.corrected: Soulflare replaced with Mantra-Q in the fields edited; Courage's 22s rank-1 timer and Decisive Strike's 8s written in; the auto-reset wind-up added to the don'ts; wants.you[2] rewritten as a clean instruction.
sources: kit: Garen Q cd 8, silence + autoReset

edits.before: Garen has no item scaling and no late spike; your AP items let RQ Soulflare zones and W root chip him out while you out-roam him past lane.
edits.after: Courage stacks armour and MR off every kill and Demacian Justice stays true damage, so your chip blunts while his execute never stops threatening you.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: You drift to utility while his stacked MR blunts your chip — peel and shield, and never duel a Garen with R up.

edits.before: If you survived lane you reclaim it: Garen has almost no item scaling, so RQ Soulflare zones and W (Focused Resolve) root chip him out from range while you out-roam him — but only if you weren't already snowballed out of the game.
edits.after: Courage's passive stacks armour and magic resist off every kill, so your Mantra-Q zones chip for less while Demacian Justice stays true damage no shield or MR blunts — poke objectives, peel, and never contest him alone here.

edits.before: Your first AP item (Lost Chapter / Liandry's line) finally makes Q/RQ Soulflare poke hurt and your E shield meaningful — the one window Skill decides, so only step up to trade Q when his Q-silence and W (damage cut + tenacity) are both on cooldown.
edits.after: Your first AP item (Lost Chapter / Liandry's line) finally makes Q and Mantra-Q poke hurt and your E shield meaningful — the one window Skill decides, so only step up to trade when Decisive Strike (8s) and Courage are both down.

edits.before: Bait his W (Focused Resolve) — wrong, that's yours; bait HIS W damage-reduction down first, then land your W tether and RW root to punish him once he commits or tries to disengage
edits.after: Bait Courage down first — its damage reduction and tenacity blunt everything — then land your Focused Resolve tether and Mantra-W root once he commits or tries to disengage

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction on cast — your burst only lands full once it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, damage reduction plus tenacity, so your burst and your root only land full once it is down. - Your E shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: That is Garen’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Decisive Strike auto reset — the wind-up is your cue to leave.
